findings.detail: Five blank issuer/investment subtotal rows from the schedule were treated as PRIVATE_CREDIT positions, causing missing interest_rate and basis_spread warnings.

rationale: The raw SOI loan rows carry coupon/spread terms in the Investment column, but the five flagged missing-rate cases align to blank issuer/investment subtotal rows in table 5 that repeat industry cost and fair value totals. These are not loan positions with missing source rate data; they are leaked subtotal rows in the extracted private-credit holdings, so the flag is a real data error caused by subtotal leakage.
